commentary.description: A brief, user-facing summary of the changes made to the model, written in a conversational tone.

id.description: A unique identifier for this node.  Camelcase string based on the name.

name.description: A descriptive name for this node

elementType.description: A BPMN 2.0 element type.  MUST match an item in the the given component library

description.description: A short summary of this step in the process

items.description: The IDs of nodes which this node connects to. Outbound connections only. Only a single outbound connection is allowed unless this is an exclusiveGateway node

events.description: Boundary events attached to this task or subprocess. Only applicable to task and subprocess nodes.

inputs.description: Array of required inputs, as specified for this component type in the 'component library'. Empty array if no inputs are required. Each entry may be a primitive type or an object.

iterationConfig.description: If this node should repeat for each item in a collection (multi-instance), provide the iteration configuration here. Omit or set to null for non-repeating nodes. Applicable to any task or subprocess node.

elementId.description: A unique identifier for a node

name.description: Name of the input parameter, as defined for this component type in the 'component library'

value.description: Value to be assigned to the input. Either a constant value, expression, or script

variableSource.description: A `CONSTANT` value if explicitly defined, or `EXPRESSION` if the value is a Groovy expression, or `SCRIPT` if the value is a Groovy script

isProvided.description: true if value is directly provided in the runbook; false if it is inferred from context or defaulted

properties.description: Nested properties for object\-shaped inputs. A property can represent a primitive value or another object\-shaped input.

targetNode.description: The target node ID of this connection

description.description: A short text description of this connection

id.description: A unique identifier for this boundary event

name.description: A descriptive name for this boundary event

eventType.description: The type of boundary event. MUST match a boundary event component in the component library

cancelActivity.description: If true (interrupting), the parent task/subprocess is cancelled when the event fires. If false (non-interrupting), a parallel flow starts while the parent continues.

inputs.description: Inputs for this boundary event as defined in the component library

connectedTo.description: The target nodes for the flow triggered by this boundary event

list.description: Expression referencing the collection to iterate over

itemInList.description: Variable name assigned to the current element in each iteration

itemLabel.description: Display label expression for each instance

completionCondition.description: Optional expression evaluated after each instance completes; if true the remaining instances are cancelled. Omit if all instances must complete.
